ana: Need a tiny copy review for the unified landing — focusing on hero wording and the benchmarks line. Rob can you sanity check?

rob: Yep. Post the hero options.

kate: Also confirm CTA labeling. We want consistent 'Get started — free credits' across pages.

ana: Hero options: 
1) "LLM inference you can rely on: hosted, dedicated, or private"
2) "One API. Any environment. Predictable performance and cost."
3) "Serve models with predictable latency — from dev to regulated deployments"

rob: Leaning to 2 for brevity. Add subhead: "Instant API, SLA-backed pools, and private VPC options."

kate: CTA list: primary: "Get started — free credits"; secondary: "Contact sales — SLA & private deploys"; tertiary: "Benchmarks & webinar". Mobile sticky: primary only.

ana: Benchmarks microcopy: "Up to 2x lower tail latency at scale vs unmanaged endpoints. See our benchmarks and methodology."

marketing-bot: Reminder: content freeze in 24 hours.

rob: One-liner edit: change 'private deploys' to 'private deployments' in CTA and subhead.

kate: Done — keeping CTAs consistent.

ana: I'll consolidate and send to engineering for the form routing and UTM.

rob: Thx — small cleanup: remove extra dash in primary CTA.

ana: Finalized. Sending to eng.
